subject: Film & Cinema
title: Depth of Field: Sharp and Blurry
description: A fast breakdown of Depth of Field: Sharp and Blurry for builders.

hook.text: When a background goes blurry, your eye focuses exactly where the filmmaker wants. That's control.

buildup.text: Shallow depth of field isolates a subject. Deep focus keeps everything sharp.

discovery.text: Citizen Kane used deep focus to let audiences scan the entire frame for meaning.

twist.text: Shallow focus has become overused in modern cinema — everything looks like a portrait photo.

climax.text: Controlling what's sharp and what's blurry is controlling what the audience thinks about.

quiz.question: What technique did Citizen Kane pioneer?
options: Deep focus — keeping everything in the frame sharp
